Midnight clears eastern roadblock #3, intercepts following officers, then clears western #1. Track confinement and actual arrival separately.
Melantha clears eastern roadblock #4 before the second civilian arrives, intercepts following officers, then clears western #2.
Fang hands upper-inner containment to Spot. Spot and medicine retain the queue until central Steward kills it.
Friston retains three enemies; downstream Fang supplies two additional real blocking slots. #34 must block on Friston or Fang and remain in returning Steward's range.
Midnight remains the upper-outer blocker. Fang temporarily adds damage, then leaves for lower interception; no unsupported replacement or healing is credited.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception, supported by Ansel's extended healing before his rotation and her two attack skills.

Require 45 actual artillery hits; device attacks and shooter interruptions do not count. First contact around frame 2280 predicts the 45th hit around 4392, conditional on uninterrupted cadence.
formation_structure.configuration: Use supplied normal-mode debug configurations; credit no unsupported dodge, probabilistic extra healing or robot talent.

tactical_thesis: Advance Midnight before Friston, restore Spot, and fund eastern Steward with two Fang grants and a living retreat. Fang first assists the upper officer pair, then redeploys downstream of Friston to intercept lower overflow and final armor #34. After artillery settlement, Ansel rotates to heal that downstream position. This is a complete, unsimulated current-model hypothesis with narrow upper-outer survival and medical-handoff predictions, not a demonstrated win.
